apps.app_name_desc: Application Name, as shown on Moonlight 3D
apps.applications_reorder_desc: Drag and drop apps to reorder the apps. Any changes made will terminate the current running app.
apps.auto_detach: Continue streaming if the application exits quickly
apps.auto_detach_desc: This will attempt to automatically detect launcher-type apps that close quickly after launching another program or instance of themselves. When a launcher-type app is detected, it is treated as a detached app.
apps.close_warning: Are you sure to terminate the current running app?
apps.cmd_desc: The main application to start. If blank, no application will be started.
apps.cmd_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in quotes.
apps.cmd_prep_desc: A list of commands to be run before/after this application. If any of the prep-commands fail, starting the application is aborted.
apps.detached_cmds_desc: A list of commands to be run in the background.
apps.detached_cmds_note: If the path to the command executable contains spaces, you must enclose it in quotes.
apps.env_client_audio_config: The Audio Configuration requested by the client (2.0/5.1/7.1)
apps.env_client_fps: The FPS requested by the client (float)
apps.env_client_hdr: HDR is enabled by the client (true/false)
apps.env_client_height: The Height requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_host_audio: The client has requested host audio (true/false)
apps.env_client_width: The Width requested by the client (int)
apps.env_client_uuid: UUID of the client starting the stream (string)
apps.env_client_name: Name of the client starting the stream (string)
apps.env_vars_desc: All commands get these environment variables by default:
apps.exit_timeout_desc: Number of seconds to wait for all app processes to gracefully exit when requested to quit. If unset, the default is to wait up to 5 seconds. If set to zero or a negative value, the app will be immediately terminated.
apps.global_prep_desc: Enable/Disable the execution of Global Prep Commands for this application.
apps.image_desc: Application icon/picture/image path that will be sent to client. Image must be a PNG file. If not set, Sunshine 3D will send default box image.
apps.output_desc: The file where the output of the command is stored, if it is not specified, the output is ignored
apps.run_as_desc: This can be necessary for some applications that require administrator permissions to run properly. Might cause URL schemes to fail.
apps.wait_all: Continue streaming until all app processes exit
apps.wait_all_desc: This will continue streaming until all processes started by the app have terminated. When unchecked, streaming will stop when the initial app process exits, even if other app processes are still running.
apps.working_dir_desc: The working directory that should be passed to the process. For example, some applications use the working directory to search for configuration files. If not set, Sunshine 3D will default to the parent directory of the command
apps.library_subtitle: Choose what appears in Moonlight 3D and arrange your app library.
apps.drag_hint: Drag cards to change their order in Moonlight 3D.
apps.no_results_desc: Try a different name or command.
apps.no_covers: No covers found. Try adjusting the application name.

config.adapter_name_desc_windows: Manually specify a GPU to use for capture. If unset, the GPU is chosen automatically. We strongly recommend leaving this field blank to use automatic GPU selection! Note: This GPU must have a display connected and powered on. The appropriate values can be found using the following command:
config.address_family_desc: Set the address family used by Sunshine 3D
config.bind_address_desc: Optionally bind Sunshine 3D to one local IP address. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces. Use an IPv4 address with IPv4 only, or an IPv6 address with IPv4+IPv6.
config.always_send_scancodes_desc: Sending scancodes enhances compatibility with games and apps but may result in incorrect keyboard input from certain clients that aren't using a US English keyboard layout. Enable if keyboard input is not working at all in certain applications. Disable if keys on the client are generating the wrong input on the host.
config.audio_sink_desc_windows:
The audio device to be used when audio output is allowed on host by the client.
If unset, the device is chosen automatically.
You can get the Device ID using the following command:
config.back_button_timeout_desc: If the Back/Select button is held down for the specified number of milliseconds, a Home/Guide button press is emulated. If set to a value < 0 (default), holding the Back/Select button will not emulate the Home/Guide button.
config.cert_desc: The certificate used for the web UI and Moonlight 3D client pairing. For best compatibility, this should have an RSA-2048 public key.
config.credentials_file_desc: Store Username/Password separately from Sunshine 3D's state file.
config.ds4_back_as_touchpad_click_desc: When forcing DS4 emulation, map Back/Select to Touchpad Click
config.enable_discovery_desc: When disabled, you'll need to manually enter host IP on the client to pair.
config.enable_pairing_desc: Enable pairing for the Moonlight 3D client. This allows the client to authenticate with the host and establish a secure connection.
config.fec_percentage_desc: Percentage of error correcting packets per data packet in each video frame. Higher values can correct for more network packet loss, but at the cost of increasing bandwidth usage.
config.file_apps_desc: The file where current apps of Sunshine 3D are stored.
config.file_state_desc: The file where current state of Sunshine 3D is stored
config.gamepad_desc: Choose which type of gamepad to emulate on the host
config.gamepad_ds5_desc: Requires the Sunshine 3D DualSense helper, HIDMaestro 1.6.2 and its USB/IP driver. If unavailable, Sunshine uses the existing ViGEm controller backend.
config.ds5_audio_haptics_desc: Forward game-authored haptic waveforms when both the DualSense audio backend and the client support them. Regular rumble remains available without PCM support.
config.global_prep_cmd_desc: Configure a list of commands to be executed before or after running any application. If any of the specified preparation commands fail, the application launch process will be aborted.
config.hide_tray_controls_desc: Do not show "Force Stop", "Restart" and "Quit" in tray menu.
config.high_resolution_scrolling_desc: When enabled, Sunshine 3D will pass through high resolution scroll events from Moonlight 3D clients. This can be useful to disable for older applications that scroll too fast with high resolution scroll events.
config.key_repeat_delay_desc: Control how fast keys will repeat themselves. The initial delay in milliseconds before repeating keys.
config.key_repeat_frequency_desc: How often keys repeat every second. This configurable option supports decimals.
config.locale_desc: The locale used for Sunshine 3D's user interface.
config.min_log_level_desc: The minimum log level printed to standard out
config.diagnostics_desc: Collect actual GPU inference/reuse counts and capture, conversion, encoder, network, and local-display timing. Fresh and repeated frames report content age separately. Disabled mode avoids diagnostic clocks, counters, GPU queries/readbacks, and filesystem polling.
config.log_path_desc: The file where the current logs of Sunshine 3D are stored.
config.max_bitrate_desc: The maximum bitrate (in Kbps) that Sunshine 3D will encode the stream at. If set to 0, it will always use the bitrate requested by the client.
config.minimum_fps_target_desc: The lowest effective FPS a stream can reach. Set 0 for automatic.
config.local_ar_virtual_display_only: Use only the virtual desktop with local AR glasses
config.local_ar_virtual_display_only_desc: On by default. Makes the private virtual desktop primary and disables other desktop displays while local AR presentation is active. The glasses remain active for video, and the mouse stays confined to the virtual desktop. Turn this off to keep the current extended desktop layout. Save and restart Sunshine 3D to apply changes.
config.local_display_surface_desc: Only the chosen display can start local 3D. Save and restart Sunshine 3D after changing it.
config.local_monitor_display_id_desc: The saved selection follows this monitor's device identity. Choose its resolution and a fixed high refresh rate in Windows Display settings.
config.local_monitor_emitter_port_desc: Connect the Open3DOLED emitter over USB and select its Windows COM port.
config.local_monitor_ir_protocol_desc: Finite shutter windows support NVIDIA 3D Vision (2), Sony (4), Panasonic (5), and Panasonic custom firmware (6).
config.local_monitor_frame_delay_us_desc: Leave time for the emitter to schedule its IR pulse. Delay plus duration must fit both the emitter timer and the selected eye interval.
config.local_monitor_frame_duration_us_desc: Leave room for the protocol's open pulse and IR spacing. The shutter window and close-pulse margin must fit the selected eye interval.
config.local_monitor_signal_spacing_us_desc: Time between IR signals, at least 30 microseconds to leave room for firmware gap scheduling. The protocol's longest token plus this spacing must fit the emitter's pulse timer.
config.local_monitor_emitter_averaging: Let the emitter keep the shutter rhythm
config.local_monitor_emitter_averaging_desc: The emitter spaces the shutter signals evenly and uses each eye command only to correct its rhythm. Try it when lenses black out briefly at a short eye interval. After a late image the glasses pause for a moment while the rhythm restarts.
config.virtual_display_restart_explorer: Restore the taskbar after virtual display removal
config.virtual_display_restart_explorer_desc: Off by default. Enable this only if Windows loses taskbar running-app indicators after the final virtual display is removed. Sunshine 3D will then restart Explorer after future removals. File Explorer windows may close and may not reopen automatically; active Explorer file operations may be interrupted.
config.motion_as_ds4: Emulate a DS4 gamepad if the client gamepad reports motion sensors are present
config.motion_as_ds4_desc: If disabled, motion sensors will not be taken into account during gamepad type selection.
config.native_pen_touch_desc: When enabled, Sunshine 3D will pass through native pen/touch events from Moonlight 3D clients. This can be useful to disable for older applications without native pen/touch support.
config.nvenc_latency_over_power: Prefer lower encoding latency over power savings
config.nvenc_latency_over_power_desc: Sunshine 3D requests maximum GPU clock speed while streaming to reduce encoding latency. Disabling it is not recommended since this can lead to significantly increased encoding latency.
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi: Present OpenGL/Vulkan on top of DXGI
config.nvenc_opengl_vulkan_on_dxgi_desc: Sunshine 3D can't capture fullscreen OpenGL and Vulkan programs at full frame rate unless they present on top of DXGI. This is system-wide setting that is reverted on Sunshine 3D program exit.
config.nvenc_preset_desc: Higher numbers improve compression (quality at given bitrate) at the cost of increased encoding latency. Recommended to change only when limited by network or decoder, otherwise similar effect can be accomplished by increasing bitrate.
config.nvenc_realtime_hags: Use realtime priority in hardware accelerated gpu scheduling
config.nvenc_realtime_hags_desc: Currently NVIDIA drivers may freeze in encoder when HAGS is enabled, realtime priority is used and VRAM utilization is close to maximum. Disabling this option lowers the priority to high, sidestepping the freeze at the cost of reduced capture performance when the GPU is heavily loaded.
config.nvenc_spatial_aq_desc: Assign higher QP values to flat regions of the video. Recommended to enable when streaming at lower bitrates.
config.nvenc_hevc_unidirectional_b_desc: Enabled by default. Replaces HEVC P pictures with past-reference-only B pictures for better compression without conventional B-frame reordering delay. Requires GPU support and cannot be combined with weighted prediction.
config.nvenc_split_encode_desc: Enabled by default. Splits packed side-by-side frames wider than 4096 pixels across the GPU's NVENC engines so wide 3D streams keep their frame rate. Disable to test whether encoder stalls follow split encoding; one engine may then not sustain the requested frame rate.
config.nvenc_twopass_desc: Adds preliminary encoding pass. This allows to detect more motion vectors, better distribute bitrate across the frame and more strictly adhere to bitrate limits. Disabling it is not recommended since this can lead to occasional bitrate overshoot and subsequent packet loss.
config.nvenc_vbv_increase_desc: The default value of 100 doubles the single-frame VBV/HRD buffer, providing headroom for complex frames while retaining low-latency rate control. Set 0 for a strict single-frame buffer. Larger values may improve quality but can cause packet loss if the network lacks headroom for bitrate spikes. The maximum value of 400 provides a 5x encoded-frame upper size limit.
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_desc: The origin of the remote endpoint address that is not denied access to Web UI
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_lan: Only those in LAN may access Web UI
config.origin_web_ui_allowed_pc: Only localhost may access Web UI
config.output_name_desc_windows: Manually specify a display device id to use for capture. If unset, the primary display is captured. Note: If you specified a GPU above, this display must be connected to that GPU. During Sunshine 3D startup, you should see the list of detected displays. Below is an example; the actual output can be found in the Troubleshooting tab.
config.packetsize_desc: Optionally cap the client-requested video packet size to avoid fragmentation on low-MTU Wi-Fi or VPN links. Use 0 to disable, or 200-65459 bytes. Smaller packets add overhead and may require a lower bitrate.
config.packetsize_invalid: Use 0 for the automatic MTU, or a value from 200 through 65459 bytes.
config.ping_timeout_desc: How long to wait in milliseconds for data from Moonlight 3D before shutting down the stream
config.session_resume_grace_desc: How long, in milliseconds, to keep the app, virtual display, and host streaming setup ready after the client disconnects. Reconnecting during this window resumes immediately. Use 0 to terminate immediately unless an accepted replacement client is still completing its handshake; maximum 600000 (10 minutes).
config.pkey_desc: The private key used for the web UI and Moonlight 3D client pairing. For best compatibility, this should be an RSA-2048 private key.
config.port_desc: Set the family of ports used by Sunshine 3D
config.port_http_port_note: Use this port to connect with Moonlight 3D.
config.port_warning: Exposing the Web UI to the internet is a security risk! Proceed at your own risk!
config.sbs_3d_max_encode_width_desc: Cap the packed side-by-side output width. The final size respects the codec's NVENC width and height limits and preserves aspect ratio to pixel alignment. Width is rounded down to a multiple of four so both eyes have even widths.
config.sunshine_name_desc: The name displayed by Moonlight 3D. If not specified, the PC's hostname is used
config.system_tray_desc: Whether to show Sunshine 3D icon in the system tray
config.touchpad_as_ds4: Emulate a DS4 gamepad if the client gamepad reports a touchpad is present
config.touchpad_as_ds4_desc: If disabled, touchpad presence will not be taken into account during gamepad type selection.
config.microphone_enabled_desc: Receive microphone audio from compatible clients. Also grant Microphone Input permission to the paired client. Disabled unless an active virtual cable is configured below.
config.microphone_sink_desc: Enter the exact VB-Audio cable playback endpoint name or ID from tools\audio-info.exe (for example, CABLE Input (VB-Audio Virtual Cable)). Select the matching CABLE Output recording device in the PC game or voice app. An empty or unavailable endpoint disables forwarding.
config.virtual_sink_desc:
The audio device to be used when audio output isn't allowed on host by the client.
If unset, the device is chosen automatically.
We strongly recommend leaving this field blank to use automatic device selection!
config.settings_intro: Everyday options are collected here. Technical controls remain available when you need them.
config.settings_advanced_desc: Advanced host configuration. Changes apply to all future sessions.
config.settings_load_failed: Could not load host settings: {reason}. Refresh the page to try again.
config.save_timing_limits_failed: Could not load emitter timing limits for saving: {reason}. Refresh the page and try again.
config.essentials_this_pc_desc: How Sunshine 3D appears to paired devices.
config.essentials_discovery: Show Sunshine 3D on the local network
config.essentials_discovery_desc: Lets Moonlight 3D find this PC automatically.
config.essentials_pairing_desc: Turn this off when you do not want Sunshine 3D to accept pairing requests.
config.essentials_reconnect_window_desc: Keeps the single active session ready while a device reconnects.
config.essentials_strength_desc: Controls Sunshine-generated 3D separation and the base strength for new offline conversions. Game 3D strength is set in ReShade's Sunshine 3D add-on panel.
config.essentials_web_access_note: No sign-in is required on this PC or your trusted local network. WAN access still uses credentials if enabled.
config.essentials_tray: Keep Sunshine 3D in the system tray
config.essentials_tray_desc: Recommended for quick access and everyday background use.
config.subtitle_apps_desc: Protect the bottom text of a chosen app, such as a 2D game, during Host 3D. It is off for every app until you turn it on here, and a change takes effect immediately. Browser videos and registered video players are always protected.
config.subtitle_apps_empty: No apps yet. Start a Host 3D stream and bring the app to the front; it will appear here.
config.subtitle_apps_read_failed: Could not read the application list: {reason}
config.subtitle_apps_not_saved: The change is active now but could not be saved to the configuration file.
config.local_monitor_error_port_invalid: The emitter port must be a COM port such as COM4.
config.local_monitor_error_protocol: Glasses IR protocol must be NVIDIA 3D Vision (2), Sony (4), Panasonic (5), or Panasonic custom firmware (6).
config.local_monitor_error_timing_unavailable: Emitter timing limits are unavailable. Refresh displays and ports before starting 3D.
config.local_monitor_error_delay_range: Shutter delay must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
config.local_monitor_error_duration_range: Shutter duration (leave room for the emitter pulse) must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
config.local_monitor_error_spacing_range: IR signal spacing must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
config.local_monitor_error_repeats_range: Refreshes per eye must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
config.local_monitor_error_window: Shutter delay plus shutter duration must not exceed {max} µs.
config.local_monitor_error_eye_interval: Shutter delay plus duration ({combined} µs) exceeds the selected monitor's {interval} µs eye interval. Shorten the shutter window or increase Refreshes per eye.
config.local_monitor_error_close_margin: Shutter duration plus the emitter close-pulse margin ({needed} µs) exceeds the selected monitor's {interval} µs eye interval. Shorten the shutter duration or increase Refreshes per eye.
config.local_monitor_error_feedback: Shutter delay, duration and the emitter close-pulse margin ({occupied} µs) leave no time for current-eye presentation feedback in the selected monitor's {interval} µs eye interval. Shorten the shutter window or increase Refreshes per eye.
config.local_monitor_intro: Present Host 3D or Game 3D directly on a monitor with an Open3DOLED USB emitter and active shutter glasses.
config.local_monitor_restart_note: Save and restart Sunshine 3D to apply changes. Remote streaming temporarily takes priority over local presentation.
config.local_monitor_handoff_note: Your selected monitor keeps its desktop position. Sunshine transfers its windows and cursor automatically for 3D and back for 2D; other monitors stay usable. Use borderless fullscreen for games that need to follow this handoff.
config.local_monitor_pair_rate: {rate} stereo pairs per second at the selected Windows refresh rate.
config.local_monitor_pair_contents: Each stereo pair contains one left and one right eye.
config.local_monitor_eye_repeats_desc: Repeating an eye provides a longer stable image for shutter calibration.
config.local_monitor_calibration_desc: Tune these values for your display and glasses. Timing values are in microseconds. Leave room for the emitter's IR pulse; delay and duration together must fit the assigned eye interval. Apply them with Save and restart.
config.local_monitor_vrr_note: Turn off G-SYNC, FreeSync and other variable-refresh settings for this monitor. The output alternates full-screen left and right images; the shared 3D pipeline supplies the stereo pair. Calibrate with the physical glasses before judging crosstalk.
config.local_display_intro: Choose the one display on this PC that Sunshine 3D presents to. 3D starts only when you choose Start 3D. A connecting or active remote session takes priority and is always shown on the remote device.
config.local_display_off_desc: No local 3D on this PC. Remote streaming is unaffected.
config.local_display_ar_glasses_desc: Glasses connected to this PC as a Windows display.
config.local_display_shutter_monitor_desc: A monitor with an Open3DOLED USB emitter and active shutter glasses.
config.av_driver_hint: Please ensure SudoVDA driver is installed to the latest version and enabled properly.
config.ar_status_read_failed: Could not read AR display status: {reason}
config.ar_decision_save_failed: Could not save AR display decision: {reason}
config.ar_intro: Sunshine 3D can present directly to glasses connected as a Windows display. Remote streaming temporarily takes priority over local presentation.
config.ar_empty: No monitors have been discovered yet.
config.ar_choice_saved: This choice is saved for this monitor model.

game3d_setup.title: Game 3D setup
game3d_setup.launch_prompt: Launch a game in Game 3D mode
game3d_setup.chosen_hint_helper: You chose this application for conversion. Sunshine 3D converts its picture with its own depth and keeps its text readable, with a small text helper loaded into it only while it runs. Nothing is written into its folder. It takes effect at once and again each time the application starts.
game3d_setup.chosen_hint_picture: You chose this application for conversion. Sunshine 3D converts its picture with its own depth and keeps its text readable from the picture alone. Nothing is written into its folder. It takes effect at once and again each time the application starts.
game3d_setup.text_game_hint_helper: This looks like a 2D text game, which has no depth of its own. Sunshine 3D converts its picture with its own depth and uses a small text helper, loaded into the game only while it runs, to keep the game's text readable. Nothing is written into the game's folder. Choose it only for an application you recognize as a single-player game. It takes effect at once and again each time the game starts.
game3d_setup.text_game_hint_picture: This looks like a 2D text game, which has no depth of its own and composes its text itself. Sunshine 3D converts its picture with its own depth and keeps the text readable from the picture alone. Nothing is loaded into the game or written into its folder. It takes effect at once and again each time the game starts.
game3d_setup.stop_hint_helper: Stopping ends the conversion at once; a helper already loaded stays in the game until it closes.
game3d_setup.stop_hint: Stopping ends the conversion at once.
game3d_setup.install_reshade_hint: Installing writes ReShade 6.8.0 with full add-on support ({dll}, {ini}) and the Sunshine 3D add-on into the setup folder above, for this executable only. Choose it only for an application you recognize as a single-player game. It takes effect the next time you launch the game.
game3d_setup.install_addon_hint: ReShade is already installed here. Installing the missing Sunshine 3D add-on copies it and its license into the add-on folder that this game's {ini} names, disables ReShade's Generic Depth add-on and enables Game 3D there, and keeps the files it changes in {backups} in the setup folder. Once installed, the add-on is updated automatically after the game exits. It takes effect the next time you launch the game.
game3d_setup.running_game_hint: Setup leaves your running game open. New or updated components take effect the next time you launch the game.
game3d_setup.manual_close_game: Close the game before manually repairing or updating an existing add-on.
game3d_setup.manual_runtime_intro: For a fresh game folder without ReShade or another proxy DLL, install the ReShade runtime first from PowerShell:
game3d_setup.manual_runtime_note: This runtime installer preserves existing files and stops on conflicts or anti-cheat. For an existing ReShade installation, use {link}. Resolve any reported proxy conflict while preserving the existing proxy DLLs.
game3d_setup.manual_reshade_setup_link: ReShade setup with full add-on support
game3d_setup.manual_addon_intro: Once ReShade with full add-on support is installed, install the bundled Sunshine 3D add-on from PowerShell:
game3d_setup.manual_replace_hostdir: Replace {hostdir} with your Sunshine 3D installation folder.
game3d_setup.manual_launch_again: Launch the game again after setup. In ReShade, open {menu} and check {option} if stereo remains unavailable.
game3d_setup.still_2d_hint: If the game remains 2D after its next launch, confirm ReShade has full add-on support and {option} is selected under {menu}.
game3d_setup.choosable_desc: This application was in front on the streamed display, and Sunshine 3D does not take it for a 2D game by itself. If you are playing a 2D game there, such as a visual novel, you can have it converted all the same. | These applications were in front on the streamed display, and Sunshine 3D does not take them for a 2D game by itself. If you are playing a 2D game there, such as a visual novel, you can have it converted all the same.
game3d_setup.choosable_hint: Sunshine 3D then converts the application's picture with its own depth while it is in front and keeps its text readable. Where the text helper can follow the text, it is loaded into the application only while it runs. Nothing is written into its folder. Choose only an application you recognize as a single-player game. It takes effect at once and again each time the application starts, and you can stop it here at any time.
game3d_setup.unavailable_desc: Game detection or setup is unavailable. Refresh to try again.
game3d_setup.on_demand_desc: Choose Game 3D in Moonlight 3D, then launch your game fullscreen. Sunshine 3D offers to install ReShade and its Game 3D add-on for that game, or only the add-on where ReShade is already installed; nothing is written into a game folder until you confirm it here. An installed add-on is kept matched to this host automatically.
game3d_setup.waiting_desc: Game 3D is active. Launch your game fullscreen on the streamed display to check its setup.
game3d_setup.ready_to_install_desc: Sunshine 3D can set up Game 3D for this executable. Nothing is written until you confirm.
game3d_setup.declined_desc: You chose not to set up this game. Sunshine 3D does not change its folder.
game3d_setup.anti_cheat_desc: Anti-cheat detected, so Sunshine 3D does not install ReShade for this game.
game3d_setup.missing_reshade_desc: ReShade with full add-on support is not installed for this game.
game3d_setup.missing_addon_desc: ReShade is installed without the Sunshine 3D add-on.
game3d_setup.installing_desc: Installing the confirmed components beside this game.
game3d_setup.installed_desc: ReShade and the Sunshine 3D add-on are installed. They will activate the next time you launch the game.
game3d_setup.current_desc: The installed Sunshine 3D add-on matches this host.
game3d_setup.update_available_desc: A matching bundled add-on update is available for this game.
game3d_setup.update_pending_desc: The matching bundled add-on update will be applied when its files are available. It will activate the next time you launch the game.
game3d_setup.updated_desc: The Sunshine 3D add-on was updated from this host’s bundled copy. It will activate the next time you launch the game.
game3d_setup.text_ready_to_install_desc: Sunshine 3D can convert this game. Nothing is loaded or converted until you confirm.
game3d_setup.text_declined_desc: You chose not to set up this game. Sunshine 3D loads nothing into it.
game3d_setup.text_anti_cheat_desc: Anti-cheat detected, so Sunshine 3D loads nothing into this game.
game3d_setup.text_current_desc: Sunshine 3D converts this game while it is in front.
game3d_setup.text_installed_desc: The game is converted the next time it starts.
game3d_setup.checking_detected_desc: Checking setup for the detected game.

index.intro: Your PC is the one place to pair devices, choose apps, and check 3D readiness.
index.game_waiting_title_unnamed: A game is waiting for your approval
index.game_waiting_desc: Game 3D found this game and does nothing with it until you choose.
index.idle_ready_desc: Sunshine 3D is ready when you open this PC in Moonlight 3D.
index.idle_pair_desc: Pair a device running Moonlight 3D to start streaming from this PC.
index.keeping_app_ready: Sunshine 3D is keeping {app} ready for a quick reconnect.
index.private_display_auto_desc: Sunshine 3D will use the best available display for the device.
index.hero_attention_desc: Open diagnostics for a plain view of the latest host issue.
index.hero_live_desc: {app} is the only active session on this PC.
index.hero_resume_desc: {app} is being kept ready for your remote device.
index.hero_pair_desc: Connect through Moonlight 3D once, then this PC will be ready whenever you return.
index.hero_ready_desc: Open Sunshine 3D in Moonlight 3D to start this PC’s single streaming session.
index.issue_ai3d_desc: 2D streaming is still available while the depth engine is checked.
index.streaming_fatal_desc: Resolve the startup issue before beginning a stream.
index.streaming_ready_desc: Hardware video encoding is available for Moonlight 3D.
index.streaming_auto_desc: Sunshine 3D chooses the best encoder when streaming begins.
index.ai3d_error_desc: 2D remains available while the depth engine is checked.
index.ai3d_ready_desc: Real-time depth is loaded for AI 3D mode in Moonlight 3D.
index.ai3d_on_demand_desc: Sunshine 3D prepares AI 3D when Moonlight 3D requests it.
index.overview_refresh_failed: Sunshine 3D could not refresh this overview. Check that the host service is still running.
index.action_failed_fallback: Sunshine 3D could not complete the action
index.end_session_confirm: End the current session on this PC? The connected device will be disconnected.

local_monitor_session.intro_ar_glasses: Start 3D when you want to use the glasses connected to this PC. Return to 2D to restore your ordinary desktop.
local_monitor_session.intro_shutter_monitor: Start 3D when you want to use the shutter glasses. Return to 2D to restore your ordinary desktop.

local_monitor_session.waiting_shutter_monitor: Waiting for the selected monitor, emitter, or local presentation ownership.

offline_conversion.title: Offline 3D Conversion
offline_conversion.intro: Analyze or convert with the same causal Host SBS estimator, camera, conditioning, and renderer used online. Offline work is not playback-paced: frames run in source order as fast as the decoder, GPU, and encoder permit.
offline_conversion.windows_nvidia_only_desc: Version 1 requires the native Windows D3D11, TensorRT, and NVENC pipeline.
offline_conversion.static_hdr_supported_desc: Static PQ and HLG input stays on the 10-bit HEVC or AV1 path. Dolby Vision and dynamic HDR10+ metadata fail closed until their metadata can be preserved correctly.
offline_conversion.preparing_desc: Saved jobs will appear when preparation finishes. This page updates automatically.
offline_conversion.updates_delayed_desc: The displayed job data may be stale. Sunshine 3D is retrying automatically: {error}
offline_conversion.live_stream_active: End the current stream before starting an offline job
offline_conversion.live_stream_active_desc: Normal Sunshine 3D streaming continues unchanged. The host prevents offline conversion from sharing its GPU until the current Moonlight session ends.
offline_conversion.action_failed: The job action did not finish
offline_conversion.convert_video_desc: Run the causal production pipeline once and encode each SBS frame
offline_conversion.analyze_only_desc: Run the same causal pass and its source checks without encoding video
offline_conversion.input_path_desc: Choose one non-empty regular video file on this Windows PC, or enter its absolute path.
offline_conversion.choose_output_label: Choose the output video file name
offline_conversion.output_name_desc: A safe name is filled from the selected input. The output stays beside that input; existing files are never overwritten.
offline_conversion.output_saved_as: The video will be saved as {path}.
offline_conversion.hevc_desc: Default · 10-bit for HDR · hardware preflight runs when the job starts
offline_conversion.codec_not_packaged: Not included in the packaged FFmpeg
offline_conversion.av1_desc: Optional · 10-bit for HDR · hardware preflight runs when the job starts
offline_conversion.codec_desc: Static HDR uses 10-bit output; SDR uses 8-bit output. The selected NVENC path is verified only after the offline job owns the GPU. Stop live streaming before conversion; startup never probes NVENC.
offline_conversion.start_help_evaluate: Choose an input file, then start analysis. Missing fields are highlighted when you submit.
offline_conversion.start_help_convert: Choose the input and output files, then start conversion. Missing fields are highlighted when you submit.
offline_conversion.interrupted_desc: The Sunshine 3D job manager stopped before a verified checkpoint could be committed. Restart creates a new job with the same immutable settings.
offline_conversion.no_jobs_desc: Choose a job type and source, then complete the settings shown for that job.
offline_conversion.folder_placeholder: Choose a drive or enter a local folder
offline_conversion.no_entries: No files or folders are available here.
offline_conversion.truncated: This folder has more entries than the picker can show. Enter a more specific folder path above.
offline_conversion.picker_output_name_desc: Use a new name ending in {mkv} or {mp4}. Existing videos are never overwritten.
offline_conversion.path_not_selected: The path could not be selected
offline_conversion.start_blocked_reconnect: Reconnect to the offline job manager before starting.
offline_conversion.start_blocked_active_job: Wait for the active offline job to finish or cancel it.
offline_conversion.start_blocked_live_stream: End the current live stream before starting an offline job.
offline_conversion.start_blocked_codec: Choose an NVENC codec included with the packaged FFmpeg.
offline_conversion.picker_unsupported: This browser does not support the file selection dialog.
offline_conversion.choose_input_before_output: Choose an input video before choosing the output file name.
offline_conversion.browse_remote_input: For safety, browse host files from the Web UI opened on this PC. You can still enter an absolute input path manually.
offline_conversion.browse_remote_output: For safety, choose host files from the Web UI opened on this PC. Enter a new output filename manually in the conversion form.
offline_conversion.browse_missing_input: This Sunshine 3D build does not include host file browsing. Enter an absolute input path manually.
offline_conversion.browse_missing_output: This Sunshine 3D build does not include host file browsing. Enter a new output filename manually in the conversion form.
offline_conversion.output_exists: That output file already exists. Choose a new file name.
offline_conversion.retained_reported: Reported by the built-in job manager
offline_conversion.cleanup_wait: Wait for the built-in job manager to mark retained paths safe to remove.
offline_conversion.wrong_job_detail: The offline job manager returned the wrong job detail.
offline_conversion.manager_unreachable: The built-in offline job manager could not be reached.
offline_conversion.restart_incomplete_settings: The interrupted job did not retain a complete immutable settings record.
offline_conversion.cancel_confirm: Cancel this offline job? Output already written remains subject to the native cleanup contract.
offline_conversion.clear_confirm: Clear this finished job? Temporary job files and history will be removed. The converted video will be kept.
offline_conversion.job_id_required: A conversion job id is required.
offline_conversion.browse_type_invalid: The file browser type is invalid.

pin.qr_single_use: The pairing code is single-use and expires after three minutes.
pin.scan_with_moonlight_desc: Open Moonlight 3D on your device and scan this code. The device will appear below as soon as it is paired.
pin.remote_devices_desc: Paired devices can browse Sunshine 3D, but only one device can stream at a time.
pin.access_stream_control_desc: Browse and launch apps, stream video, and use controller, mouse, and keyboard input.
pin.access_view_only_desc: Browse and view streams without launching apps or controlling this PC.
pin.access_custom_desc: Choose individual permissions in Advanced settings.
pin.clipboard_sharing_desc: Allow text to move between this PC and the device.
pin.no_devices_desc: Pair a device running Moonlight 3D to start streaming.
pin.remove_all_desc: Every device will need to be paired again. An active stream will also be stopped.
pin.pairing_expired: The pairing link expired. Start pairing again to create a new one.
